title: Branded landing
logic: Explain the enquiry-to-approval journey; show synthetic-demo notice; expose Start demo and architecture links; display the supplied bilingual logo without stretching.
errors: Missing repository link hides that action; logo has meaningful alternative text; no affiliation claim.

title: Demo scenarios and assets
logic: Seed four deterministic scenarios: mixed-language photo, missing serial, incompatible part, local shortage; derive identifiers from seed 42; validate expected outcomes against generated records.
errors: Reject a scenario whose expected part lacks compatibility; reject stock claims not supported by fixture quantities.

title: Demo role switching
logic: Switch the presentation between customer and reviewer using the same anonymous identity and session; authorize review only for enquiries belonging to that active session.
errors: Forged reviewer role never grants staff membership; another visitor's enquiry returns 404.

title: Demo isolation
logic: Bind each session to verified anonymous Supabase identity; check generation and expiry on every read, write and worker completion; exclude demos from operational metrics by default.
errors: Expired, reset and foreign sessions fail; missing identity context returns no rows.

title: Demo reset
logic: Lock session; increment generation; cancel unfinished jobs from prior generation; enqueue Storage cleanup; keep minimal audit; create fresh scenario enquiries on explicit selection.
errors: Late OCR from old generation cannot update current data; repeated reset idempotency key returns the same generation.

title: Responsive layouts
logic: Support 360,768,1280 CSS-pixel widths; stack review panels; horizontally scroll comparison tables within their region; preserve sticky primary review actions without covering content.
errors: No page-wide horizontal overflow; zoom 200 percent remains usable; mobile dialogs retain visible close action.

title: Arabic and English interface
logic: Use a locale cookie and complete en/ar message catalogs; persist preference; set document lang and dir; isolate serials, numbers and part identifiers with bdi.
errors: Missing translation fails tests; language switch preserves enquiry ID and unsent draft; mixed Arabic identifiers remain readable.

title: Light and dark themes
logic: Use CSS semantic tokens; initialize from saved preference then system setting; expose accessible toggle; honor reduced motion and browser color-scheme.
errors: No hydration mismatch; chart colors and focus rings meet contrast checks; storage-disabled browsers still work.

title: Bilingual chat
logic: Accept Arabic, English and mixed text; preserve original message; detect preferred reply locale; render customer messages immediately after successful persistence.
errors: Empty and oversized input returns validation error; HTML is escaped; retry does not duplicate a message.

title: Structured extraction
logic: Extract item descriptions, quantities, urgency and machine hints with strict structured outputs; preserve source spans; missing quantity becomes a clarification rather than assumed order quantity.
errors: Unknown keys and invalid quantities reject the response; unsupported model output cannot progress to search.

title: Clarifying questions
logic: Use controller reason codes to choose code-owned bilingual questions; persist interrupt; associate answer with item; rerun affected resolution only.
errors: No final recommendation before approval; contradictory answer requires confirmation; repeat event creates one question.

title: Conversation memory
logic: Persist all messages and typed current state; compact context using retained structured facts; resume by enquiry/revision; never mix customer sessions.
errors: Restart retains unresolved questions; old revision events are ignored and audited; foreign thread ID denied.

title: Private uploads
logic: Create pending attachment and unique object path; use signed upload; validate actual bytes and magic type after confirmation; strip EXIF and cap decoded pixels before OCR.
errors: Wrong MIME, oversized content, image decompression bomb, duplicate confirmation and nonexistent object handled explicitly.

title: Nameplate OCR
logic: Read validated nameplate via OpenAI vision; return model_text,serial_text,issues and source attachment; persist result only with current lease and revision.
errors: Unreadable fields remain null; vision instructions in photo are untrusted; timeout is bounded and creates recoverable status.

title: OCR confirmation
logic: Show cropped or original nameplate beside extracted identifiers; require user confirm or correction; record actor and time; preserve leading zeros in serial text.
errors: Unconfirmed OCR never authorizes matching; blank corrected serial triggers missing-serial flow; stale confirmation returns 409.

title: Photo quality feedback
logic: Check decodability, dimensions and blur heuristic before paid call; return actionable retake instructions; mark heuristic as advisory; allow a readable image despite noncritical blur warning.
errors: Unsupported format rejected; dark or low-resolution sample gets guidance; no fabricated OCR confidence percentage.

title: Multi-part enquiries
logic: Track up to 20 items with independent quantity, machine, candidate selection and status; clarify individual items; verify aggregate allocation for repeated part requests.
errors: One unresolved item blocks final all-items approval; allocations across duplicate parts cannot double count available stock; zero quantity rejected.

title: Progress timeline
logic: Show persisted stages, wait reason and last update; poll with bounded backoff; reconnect using server state; separate waiting for customer from waiting for staff.
errors: No fake completed progress; failed poll retains last state and offers retry; hidden tabs reduce polling.

title: Enquiry history
logic: Return cursor-paginated owned history with status and created time; filter active demo generation; link to full conversation; use stable created_at/id ordering.
errors: Foreign owner ID ignored; invalid cursor returns 422; equal timestamps do not duplicate or skip records.

title: Machine identification
logic: Preserve identify_machine logic for model, serial and rating; return resolved configuration or explicit missing/ambiguous status; normalize numeric serial only after preserving input.
errors: Boundary serials match exactly one configuration; overlapping ranges fail database insertion; conflicting hints never silently override.

title: Machine mismatch detection
logic: Compare model and serial together; return mismatch reason with safe next question; prevent retrieval while identity unresolved.
errors: Valid serial of a different model does not match requested model; nonnumeric serial handled without crashing.

title: Compatibility gate
logic: Fetch authoritative fitment set first; rank only members; carry source_reference and catalogue version through every candidate.
errors: A perfect lexical match outside fitment is absent; empty fitment returns unavailable; blank provenance cannot be published.

title: Aliases and typo matching
logic: Preserve Arabic normalization, part-number keys, phrase scoring and fuzzy token matching; remove machine terms using resolved model context.
errors: Arabic part words are not removed as machine words; exact part number outranks unrelated fuzzy alias; normalization parity test matches SQL.

title: Semantic retrieval
logic: Load one BGE-M3 encoder per search process; use normalized 1024-d vectors; retain legacy weighted fusion; fall back to lexical on unavailable embedding path.
errors: Wrong dimension rejected; no model loaded in worker; no semantic candidate outside compatible IDs.

title: Ranked candidates
logic: Return top candidates with lexical/semantic evidence and deterministic tie order; compute runner-up margin before applying response limit.
errors: Limit one still reports ambiguity; empty set returns no candidate; NaN scores rejected.

title: Ambiguity handling
logic: Use tested score and margin thresholds in code; ask customer to distinguish fuel filter versus separator; allow staff to select only verified candidates.
errors: LLM cannot override low confidence; unavailable candidate choice returns 409; thresholds evaluated on labelled cases.

title: Match explanations
logic: Show actual alias, machine configuration, supersession chain and fitment reference; derive explanations from search evidence rather than invented model prose.
errors: Absent evidence shown as unavailable; user HTML is escaped; scores never labelled calibrated probability.

title: Compatibility references
logic: Resolve source_reference to version-specific document and page; retain citation with every candidate and approval snapshot.
errors: Missing source file blocks evidence viewer and flags review; mismatched version fails verification.

title: Evidence page viewer
logic: Authorize assigned reviewer or own demo reviewer; request short-lived worker-signed PDF URL; open exact cited page; label synthetic document.
errors: Customer receives reference only; arbitrary Storage key rejected; expired link can be renewed after authorization.

title: Old part numbers
logic: Follow supersession chain with cycle protection; display old and current numbers; verify current successor has explicit fitment for resolved configuration.
errors: Cycles rejected; inactive terminal part returns unavailable; inherited compatibility without source is rejected.

title: Candidate comparison
logic: Compare two or three candidates from the same item/revision; show number, names, evidence and warehouse availability; selecting a candidate sends its ID, not browser-authored facts.
errors: Foreign candidate or stale revision rejected; missing attribute shown as unavailable; keyboard navigation works.

title: Warehouse stock
logic: Show available quantity as on_hand minus reserved; include timestamp and warehouse name; keep display and planner using same snapshot.
errors: Negative stock blocked; stock unavailable never displayed as zero without explanation; unknown warehouse rejected.

title: Fulfilment planning
logic: Allocate local stock first then reachable warehouses deterministically; compute shortage; use quantity units; do not reserve stock or create orders.
errors: Total allocations never exceed request or stock; fractional quantities respect unit policy; unavailable transfer route cannot be invented.

title: Transfer estimates
logic: Carry integer transfer_days from approved route; show estimate and source warehouse; local availability means zero transfer days.
errors: No route gives unknown/unavailable plan rather than invented one-day promise; estimate labelled non-guaranteed.

title: Stock freshness
logic: Compare stock timestamp with configurable freshness limit; mark stale data in review; re-read current stock during approval; invalidate plan when allocation no longer possible.
errors: Future timestamp flagged; changed stock returns 409 and reruns planning; stale stock never becomes a delivery guarantee.

title: Staff inbox
logic: List assigned operational enquiries and own active demo enquiries; filter status,priority,overdue and text; paginate stably; show counts in same access scope.
errors: Unassigned real enquiries hidden from reviewer; admin can see all; filters do not leak global counts.

title: Review workspace
logic: Assemble current extraction, items, candidates, evidence, stock, draft and timeline; show verification failures; separate staff-only notes from customer messages.
errors: Missing panels show explicit empty states; stale revision disables approval; unassigned reviewer receives 404.

title: Correct extracted details
logic: Lock enquiry; compare expected revision; apply typed allowed corrections; increment revision; invalidate derived selections/draft/approval; enqueue recomputation; record before and after.
errors: Unknown field rejected; old revision returns 409; correction cannot directly set approved status or invent candidate facts.

title: Review actions
logic: Approve only verified current draft; edit prose through controlled schema then reverify; reject with reason; record actor and idempotency key.
errors: Double-click publishes once; concurrent edit defeats stale approval; failed verification blocks publication.

title: Approval invalidation
logic: Bind approval to revision and verified fact hash; any identity,quantity,selection or catalogue-sensitive change requires new draft and approval.
errors: Old approval cannot authorize new revision; late workflow update cannot overwrite approved current state.

title: Internal notes
logic: Append reviewer notes with author and timestamp; show only in staff workspace; prohibit customer/PDF exposure; escape rendered content.
errors: Empty or over-4000-character note rejected; customer route never includes note text; unassigned staff denied.

title: Assignments
logic: Admin assigns active reviewer or unassigns; persist assignment history atomically; access changes immediately; demo reviewer access remains session-scoped.
errors: Non-admin assignment denied; disabled/nonreviewer assignee rejected; previous reviewer loses access on next request.

title: Overdue indicators
logic: Set due_at using configurable urgent/normal thresholds; display overdue only for unresolved states; sort overdue first when requested; store all times UTC.
errors: Approved/rejected items never overdue; daylight-saving display does not change deadline; thresholds not described as contractual SLA.

title: Conversation summary
logic: Produce staff-only concise summary from authorized messages and confirmed fields; store message IDs and revision; use shared budget wrapper; regenerate on relevant change.
errors: Outdated summary labelled stale; instructions inside messages ignored; exhausted budget leaves full conversation available.

title: Reply drafting
logic: Generate greeting,explanation and closing as structured slots; code inserts all numbers and allocations; choose Arabic or English from confirmed preference.
errors: Unapproved critical facts never rendered; unsupported slots rejected; provider failure permits staff-authored controlled draft.

title: Verification gate
logic: Check item/configuration/candidate membership, provenance, catalogue version, selected quantities and allocation bounds; compute canonical fact hash; store named rule results.
errors: Unknown part, incompatible part, stale catalogue, oversold plan and hidden extra item each fail a specific rule.

title: Human publication gate
logic: Only approval service inserts recommendation messages; lock enquiry and recheck role,revision and verification; unique publication index prevents duplicates.
errors: No worker/specialist write tool can publish; database rejects recommendation lacking matching approved decision.

title: Input isolation
logic: Treat customer text,OCR and imported evidence as data; separate trusted instructions; bound tool names,arguments,steps and output size; never execute model-produced templates.
errors: Prompt injection cannot call write tools,change roles or reveal secrets; tool result with rogue instructions remains inert.

title: Audit trail
logic: Append actor,request,entity,revision and minimal before/after metadata for AI suggestions and human changes; redact secrets and full sensitive payloads.
errors: Application UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE fail; audit write failure rolls back approval; database-owner powers documented honestly.

title: Durable workflows
logic: Use Postgres checkpointer and DB event inbox; thread key includes enquiry ID and active revision; serialize processing for one enquiry; recover after restart.
errors: Duplicate events do not repeat publication; stale revision event is consumed as obsolete; checkpoint DDL never runs under runtime role.

title: Background jobs
logic: Persist job before Redis dispatch; dispatcher claims by ID; sweeper redispatches pending/expired jobs; worker handles OCR,PDF,imports and cleanup.
errors: Redis loss does not lose DB job; unavailable Redis rate limiter fails closed; heavy work never blocks HTTP intake.

title: Retry and deduplication
logic: Claim with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; assign lease token; heartbeat; retry transient errors with backoff up to max attempts; fence final writes by lease token.
errors: Expired worker cannot commit; permanent validation failure not retried; provider timeout marked uncertain and budget held conservatively.

title: Graceful failures
logic: Map stable error codes to bilingual recovery guidance; distinguish validation,quota,service outage and staff-required states; preserve user input.
errors: No raw stack traces or keys; retry only safe idempotent action; search lexical fallback clearly reported.

title: Access and permissions
logic: Verify Supabase issuer,audience,signature,expiry; derive identity server-side; enforce assigned-only review; keep credentials server-side; disable public real-client signup.
errors: Forged role claim ignored; missing context denies rows; preview cannot reach prod database; demo cannot publish shared catalogue.

title: Saved machines
logic: Save confirmed model and serial with user label; list own active entries; archive entry; prefill a new enquiry but re-identify against current catalogue.
errors: Duplicate label permitted with distinct ID; foreign ID denied; stale configuration never reused as authoritative.

title: Repeat enquiry
logic: Copy customer request and confirmed hints into a new enquiry; issue new ID/revision; link origin in audit; run matching,stock and review again.
errors: Never copy approval,allocation,draft or signed file URL; source ownership required; repeated submission deduplicated.

title: Catalogue browser
logic: Read published catalogue with model/category/text filters; page results; show part detail and supersession; staff can inspect fitment and sources.
errors: No unpublished import rows exposed; missing number returns 404; literal query cannot become SQL.

title: Catalogue imports
logic: Read CSV UTF-8 or XLSX without evaluating formulas; validate row schema,references,serial overlap,supersession cycles and source evidence; show dry-run report; explicit admin publish.
errors: Invalid batch changes no published data; file with macros/formulas rejected; 50000-row and 10MiB limits enforced; public demo cannot publish.

title: Catalogue versioning
logic: Snapshot validated catalogue canonically; hash records; serialize publication; preserve numeric IDs; atomically retire old version and activate new; invalidate pending enquiries on next action.
errors: Two publishers cannot leave two active versions; failed publish rolls back; old approval retains immutable evidence snapshot.

title: Missing-parts queue
logic: Record unresolved item once; allow assigned staff to mark investigating,resolved or unavailable with note; link back to enquiry; no automatic catalogue creation.
errors: Resolved status requires staff explanation; foreign item denied; empty search result is not fabricated stock.

title: Enquiry PDF
logic: Export approved revision only; render logo,bilingual customer text,verified selections,estimates and references; embed Arabic fonts; store private object and signed download.
errors: Exclude notes and secrets; stale or unapproved revision rejected; long Arabic names wrap without clipping; no prices or quotation title.

title: Labelled evaluations
logic: Include four demos plus Arabic,typo,serial-boundary,ambiguity,stock and injection cases; record expected compatible set and clarification outcome; run deterministic suite without API calls.
errors: No self-reported model confidence as accuracy; evaluation fixture disjoint from examples used in prompts; failures keep actual output.

title: Metrics dashboard
logic: Show volume,status,review time,clarification and labelled accuracy with denominators; separate demo traffic; filter time window; scope reviewer data to assignments.
errors: Zero denominator displays unavailable; no fabricated percentage; demo traffic never silently improves operational metrics.

title: Latency and AI cost
logic: Measure stages with monotonic clock; log model/token usage and estimated cost; reserve confirmed free credit before each attempt; expose consumed/reserved allowance.
errors: Unknown price or expired credit blocks calls; concurrent reservations cannot exceed cap; API key validity never implies free credit.

title: Correction feedback
logic: List authorized before/after corrections; let admin curate anonymized labelled eval cases; record reviewer and source revision; never auto-train on unreviewed edits.
errors: Private text excluded from exported fixtures; duplicate case source detected; unreviewed correction cannot become ground truth.

title: Tests and CI
logic: Run service-isolated Python tests,frontend checks,RLS integration and deterministic evals; build images; require explicit environment approval for deployment; pin action SHAs.
errors: No prod DB in tests; no secret available to untrusted fork jobs; failed gate blocks deployment.

title: Traces
logic: Propagate request/enquiry/job IDs; capture stage timing and safe status; export optional Langfuse traces with payload redaction; operate normally when tracing unavailable.
errors: No raw key or full photo logged; exporter outage never breaks approval; budget accounting remains local and authoritative.

title: Recruiter documentation
logic: Write concise overview,real architecture,quick start,demo paths,tests,trade-offs and limitations; link measured evidence; explain deterministic decisions and specialist tools.
errors: No invented accuracy,uptime,client relationship or production adoption; distinguish implementation status from specification.

title: Demo walkthrough
logic: Create 3-minute and 8-minute scripts covering happy path,missing serial,incompatibility,stock split and human review; include recording checklist and captions.
errors: Do not claim video exists until recorded; use synthetic data; show failure handling and reset; verify links before sending recruiters.
